title: Strength for busy people 1
author: Jarl V.
desc: 2 out of the 6 fundamental strength movements each day, 3 times a week. Ad cardio as you see fit. Whole body training with a strength focus. This is the first block out of 4 with new strength movements each block.

ex.note: 2 sets of 10 seconds + 2 sets of 30s. Work up to max weight you can hold for 10 seconds and then drop to 60% for the 30 second holds
10 sets of 10 seconds in 10 minutes. Work from an easy weight up to maximum. Done to get used to the Zercher for coming training blocks with squat and deadlift variations.

10 reps of each for a giant set.
- Front Raises (supenated) 
- Lat raises (neutral grip) 
- Bent over rear delt raises (pronated grip) 
- Cuban rotations
- Chicken wings
Randomize order week to week.
